search.query: NAFLD or NASH AND Mus musculus AND single cell or single-cell AND gse

candidates.reason: Four libraries confound HFD, exercise and library composition; no verified two independent NCD and two HFD animals.
Paired oligo and cDNA libraries do not establish independent biological animals.
Chow-diet WT versus NgBR KO RNA-seq; not an NCD-versus-HFD single-cell replication.
Whole-liver bulk RNA-seq; cannot replace single-cell animal replication.

disposition: Keep GSE270583 descriptive or add a new animal experiment with at least two independent NCD and two independent HFD animals and donor-resolved single-cell libraries.
claim_limit: No disease-significance, composition or communication inference from GSE270583 until the animal replication requirement is satisfied.
